title: On Killing tensors on Riemannian symmetric spaces
summary: A Killing tensor field on a Riemannian space corresponds to an integral of the geodesic flow polynomial in momenta. A Killing tensor field is called decomposable if it is a polynomial in Killing vector fields. In this paper, we first prove that the study of Killing tensor fields on symmetric spaces can be reduced to the case of compact irreducible ones. Then we introduce the class of top slot Killing tensor fields.
